artworks.title: The Abduction of Ganymede
artworks.description: Rubens paints the tale Orpheus sang in his grove — Jove as eagle bearing the Trojan boy to Olympus, one of the gentler songs after Phlegra's giants.

artworks.title: The Death of Hyacinth
artworks.description: Broc catches Apollo's discus and the flower that bears AI, AI — the second song in Orpheus' enchanted repertoire after Eurydice was lost.
